validations.title: Network mesh
validations.description: Checks from every target Server that each other one answers ICMP, carries a full-sized unfragmented packet, and accepts connections on its SSH port, at the address swallow reaches it by. It sends a little traffic between the Servers.

mtu.title: Expected MTU
mtu.description: The MTU every path must carry. Default: the MTU of the interface each path leaves through.

checks.title: Reachability
checks.description: Every other target Server answers ICMP echo.

checks.title: Path MTU
checks.description: A packet of the path's MTU reaches every peer that answers without fragmenting.

checks.title: SSH port
checks.description: Every other target Server accepts a TCP connection on port 22.
